fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami municipal governance, calling for a capable city manager and discussing public-utility and transportation franchises, harbor improvements, and municipal docks. Coverage highlights Miami’s convention activity (including Lions and anticipated Shriners/Elks gatherings) and proposals for a downtown auditorium with suggested sites such as Bayfront Park. Additional content includes society/column items, nightlife and prohibition-era references, and extended discussion of Florida racing and anti-racing arguments, along with legal notices for a master’s sale/foreclosure in Dade County.
